Outage.description: An outage the snow monkey injects into a route: during it, the chaos settings of the snow monkey apply to the calls of the route

descriptorId.description: The id of the route under outage (the field is named after the legacy service descriptors)

descriptorName.description: The name of the route under outage, as it was when the outage started

until.description: The time of the day the outage ends at, as `HH:mm:ss.SSS`

duration.description: The duration of the outage, in milliseconds
